extracted.summary: Ongoing WhatsApp exchange with Layla Haddad about a home purchase: she set a 3.5M max budget, needs at least 3 bedrooms, wants to be near the beach, later said a pool is non-negotiable, and needs covered parking for two cars; her husband Karim must approve any purchase, a viewing was confirmed for 14 March 2026, and both sides made small delivery promises (floor plans, mortgage pre-approval letter). Ongoing WhatsApp exchange between Sam Karimi and Layla Haddad about a property search; Layla stated requirements for parking, a ready-to-move-in property, and a home study, shared lease-related dates, and rep committed to follow up on a payment plan with the developer. Extended WhatsApp exchange with Layla Haddad about her property search with her husband Karim; she stated requirements for a home office, a workable kitchen, a ground-floor room for Karim's mother, and a floor-height limit, and mentioned the down payment will happen once her December bonus arrives. Ongoing WhatsApp exchange between rep Sam Karimi and client Layla Haddad about property options; she flagged a past developer handover delay, disliked the beige kitchens shown, asked for options in Arabian Ranches, mentioned she'll be away traveling in February, and said she'd sign if the bank approves financing by end of month. Sam committed to sending the snagging checklist before handover. Ongoing WhatsApp exchange with Layla Haddad about her property search; she wants to avoid crowded areas and value being close to the airport because her husband Karim travels frequently, raised that her current rent feels wasteful, and said she'll sign once the bank approves financing by end of month. Her sister Rania is separately looking for a 1-bed near the Marina. Ongoing WhatsApp conversation between rep Sam Karimi and client Layla Haddad about property listings; Layla promised to get a bank valuation report and Sam promised to confirm with the landlord by Wednesday, while Layla shared some family and financial context relevant to her search. Ongoing WhatsApp exchange between agent Sam Karimi and client Layla Haddad about an apartment search; several listings were shared, Layla raised concerns about a dark unit, highway noise, and working with another agent, and mentioned a gym requirement for Karim plus a colleague also looking for a 2-bed. Ongoing WhatsApp exchange between Sam Karimi and client Layla Haddad about property viewings; Layla stated she wants to close before 1 September 2026, mentioned a colleague also looking for a 2-bed, shared family details (her mum's 60th birthday and her son Adam's aquarium outings), and Sam committed to introducing her to his mortgage broker. Ongoing property search chat between rep Sam Karimi and client Layla Haddad with many listings shared; Layla rejected a Damac Hills property for lack of shade, and her required bedroom count changed from 3 to 4 after Karim's mother decided to move in. Ongoing WhatsApp property search exchange with Layla Haddad; the requirement changed from 3 to 4 bedrooms after Karim's mother decided to move in, and later the family also asked for a small investment studio for her. Layla joked about the 5M budget being a stretch and mentioned her pet Mishmish needs a netted balcony. Layla Haddad and rep Sam Karimi exchanged mostly brief acknowledgements and listing links over several weeks; Layla mentioned wanting a studio for Karim's mum as an investment and that she will be away for part of December. Ongoing WhatsApp exchange between Sam Karimi and Layla Haddad about property viewings; Sam committed to several follow-up actions after a call on 14 October, and Layla shared her husband Karim's birthday, their anniversary, and a tentative decision timeline from Karim. Mostly routine, low-content WhatsApp exchange with Layla Haddad; a meeting was confirmed for 12 November 2026, and Layla relayed that someone named Karim will probably decide by the end of the year, though she cautioned not to hold him to it.
